import json, torch, shutil
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import dataclass
from benchmarks.analysis.cuda.study import admit,occupancy
from benchmarks.analysis.cuda.manifest import MODEL,MODEL_ID,DATA,REFERENCE,DATA_SHA,INPUT_SHA,digest
from wyat.backends.kai.artifact import load_artifact
from wyat.backends.kai.encoding import KaiEncoder,EncodedRequest
from wyat.core import Request
from wyat.evaluation import case_from_dict,_input_digest
from wyat.wire import decode_json
from benchmarks.analysis.reference import read_reference
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Encoder:
 model_id:str
 encoder:KaiEncoder
 def encode_request(self,request:Request)->EncodedRequest:return self.encoder.encode_request(request)
manifest=Path('benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-transfer-manifest-v2-20261005.json')
assert digest(manifest)=='f7d9d7a4755a8df37e7e55d577489a1f9597760a68928b2a8213a0d19d3c6866'
admission=admit(manifest)
artifact=load_artifact(MODEL,512)
encoder=Encoder(artifact.model_id,KaiEncoder.from_artifact(artifact,max_length=512,token_cache_size=0))
cases=tuple(case_from_dict(decode_json(line)) for line in DATA.read_text().splitlines())
reference=read_reference(REFERENCE,cases,encoder,dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA)
assert artifact.model_id==MODEL_ID and _input_digest(cases)==INPUT_SHA and len(cases)==77
result={'admission':admission,'cases':len(cases),'all_tokens_endpoints_queries_validated':True,'reference_correct':reference.correct,'reference_failed':reference.failed,'cuda_initialized':torch.cuda.is_initialized(),'free_bytes':shutil.disk_usage(Path.cwd()).free,'occupancy':occupancy(),'torch_build':torch.__config__.show()}
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
